subject: SOC2 intake: SCIM delta + scoped-role justification — Waypoint Health
messages:
From: Ava Lewis <ava.lewis@waypointhealth.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: audit@waypointhealth.com
Date: Wed, 03 Dec 2025 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: SOC2 request — SCIM delta + RBAC snapshot

Hi Marissa,

Waypoint is preparing for their SOC 2 readout and our audit team has asked for a short intake: a recent SCIM delta export covering the last 90 days, a RBAC role-to-permission mapping (we only need the scoped roles assigned to human users), and a short narrative describing delegated admin/service-account policies.

Can you confirm whether you can provide: 
- SCIM delta (CSV or JSON) for the tenant waypointhealth.com covering 2025-09-01 -> 2025-12-01
- A role mapping CSV (role_name, description, privilege_list, owner)
- Evidence of periodic RBAC review (owner signoffs or runbook pointers)

If it's easier, email the artifacts to integrity-assessments@waypointhealth.com or upload to the Drive link I listed in the intake doc. We would like the artifacts by next Wednesday (2025-12-10) to keep the SOC2 schedule.

Thanks,
Ava
Ava Lewis
Senior Security Program Manager
Waypoint Health
[attachment: intake-form.pdf (application/pdf)]
From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: Ava Lewis <ava.lewis@waypointhealth.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, priyom_das@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 03 Dec 2025 11:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: SOC2 request — SCIM delta + RBAC snapshot

Hi Ava — thanks for the clear ask. We can provide the artifacts you outlined. Quick notes and a proposed plan: 

Plan: 
1) We'll generate a SCIM delta export (CSV) scoped to the Waypoint tenant for the requested date range.
2) We'll attach a role-to-privileges CSV and a short narrative on delegated-admin/service-account policy.
3) We'll include owner signoff artifacts (S3 path + audit log export) where available.

Timing: I can deliver a first bundle by Friday 2025-12-05 EOD PST; final bundle (including owner signoffs) by Monday 2025-12-08. If you truly need everything by 12/10 that's fine — we can accelerate.

Technical asks for you: which format is preferred for SCIM delta (CSV columns vs. JSON audit array)? We typically produce a CSV with these columns: action, timestamp, user_id, external_id, attribute_changed, old_value, new_value, source (SCIM/API). If you prefer JSON we can include that as well.

Attaching our internal export instructions so your team can verify the schema if needed.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Customer Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
[attachment: redwood-scim-export-instructions.pdf (application/pdf)]
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, Ava Lewis <ava.lewis@waypointhealth.com>
Cc: priyom_das@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 04 Dec 2025 10:41:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: SOC2 request — SCIM delta + RBAC snapshot

Ava / Marissa — adding a couple of implementation details we find helpful for SIG/SOC reviewers: 

- SCIM delta: we'll include a header row and use RFC-compliant timestamps (ISO 8601). For deltas we'll surface events of type: created, updated, deleted, and attribute_sync.
- Role mapping sample: include role_id, role_name, description, privileged_actions (comma-separated), assigned_entity_type (user/group/service_account), owner_email.
- Service Accounts: we will include a separate sheet/list for non-human principals with a justification column and last-rotation timestamp.
- Least-privilege evidence: where roles are broad we will annotate the last RBAC review date and reviewer in the mapping CSV.

Attached a role-mapping-sample.csv you can use as a template. Marissa — when we deliver the SCIM delta, please add a short README explaining filtering (we often mask internal trace IDs).

-Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Director, Applied Security
Redwood Inference
[attachment: role-mapping-sample.csv (text/csv)]
From: Ava Lewis <ava.lewis@waypointhealth.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, audit@waypointhealth.com
Date: Fri, 05 Dec 2025 08:07:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: SOC2 request — SCIM delta + RBAC snapshot

Thanks — this is helpful. Couple follow-ups: 

1) For service accounts, can you indicate the provisioning flow (SCIM vs manual) and list any out-of-band IAM mechanisms? Waypoint's auditors will want to see proof that service accounts are excluded from interactive SSO and that keys/credentials are rotated.
2) For delegated admins: any accounts with tenant-level privileges — please identify owner and the last approval timestamp.
3) Can you upload artifacts to the Drive link and drop the HubSpot record so our tracker gets updated automatically? We prefer not to receive PII over email.

I'll also send a short intake form for our legal team (DocuSign) so our compliance reviewer can accept the artifact NDA.

-Appreciate it,
Ava
From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: Ava Lewis <ava.lewis@waypointhealth.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, priyom_das@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 08 Dec 2025 09:16:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: SOC2 request — SCIM delta + RBAC snapshot

Ava — attaching the first bundle per our plan. Bundle contents (zip stub):
- scim-delta-spec.csv (SCIM events for 2025-09-01 -> 2025-12-01)
- role-mapping-sample.csv (populated for Waypoint tenant)
- owners-and-reviewers.csv (list of role owners + last review timestamps)
- delegated-admins.txt (names and approval dates)
- README.txt (fields, masking policy, export command)

Notes: 
- Service accounts are listed in a separate sheet (non-human_principals). Provisioning flow column shows origin: scim_provisioning, manual_create, or api_create. Key rotation timestamps are included where applicable; secrets for third-party connectors are rotated via our KMS schedule.
- We redacted internal trace IDs and replaced with stable export ids in the README.

Drive link: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3c-waypoint-intake (shared to your integrity-assessments group). HubSpot ticket: https://hubspot.company/contacts/12345.

If you want a short video walk-through of the CSVs we can schedule 30 minutes Wednesday or Thursday afternoon PST.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Customer Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
[attachment: scim-delta-spec.csv (text/csv)]
From: Ava Lewis <ava.lewis@waypointhealth.com>

Date: Mon, 08 Dec 2025 15:48:00 -08:00

Marissa — got the bundle, thanks. I pulled the CSVs and spot-checked a few rows; they look in scope. A couple remaining asks: 

- Can we get the delegated-admins file as a signed confirmation (owner email + signature/date) for audit? If you have a Confluence/JIRA acceptance note, that works too.
- Please add one sample log line showing the SCIM event in our requested timestamp format to the README (for the audit sample).

Let's meet for the 30-minute walk-through tomorrow at 11:00 AM PST if that slot is free for your team. I'll send a calendar invite.

Thanks — looking forward to closing this out.
Ava
